sequence: Run, then inspect stageGate raster proof and semanticLoss.
Review raster using exact expectedArtifactSha256 and decision=accepted; run again.
Inspect calibrated landmark PNG/camera. Submit decision=revise with explicit joints, bones, bindings and motions using the displayed stage and landmark plan SHAs.
Inspect the revised image and blueprint. Accept using the NEW expectedLandmarkPlanSha256; run again.
Inspect final candidate and media. Review its exact SHA with spine_review_character_task, then run publication.
limits: No anatomy inference or image generation inside MCP. Intermediate reviews and final publication review are separate. To change a consumed stage, create an explicitly reviewed branch.
